notes.title: YOUNG SOULS IS COMING IN Q1 2022
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

Months ago, we were all so thrilled to finally give you a release window. Last October, we even let you try our demo for the first time, and we were so grateful for your warm and constructive feedback. Unfortunately, today we cannot confirm this timeframe without compromising our human work ethics as well as our game quality. Therefore, [b]we have made the difficult decision to postpone Young Souls to Q1 2022.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/54529410b299bc4a16c5571162126e4ed07a498f.png[/img]

To be honest, we have been working on this project for [b]FIVE[/b] years, and we cannot possibly rush it now. Our utmost desire is to deliver the [b]finest gem[/b] we can make. It goes without saying that in doing so, we will not let our team be pressured as it is not our internal policy to do such a thing. Indeed, we are a small team, and the quality of our game is just as important as the health of our fellow developers (whom we love and cherish).

In the end, we are just as pained as you are, if not more so. Still, sometimes tough decisions have to be made for the best of our team, you, and our game.

On behalf of the entire Young Souls team, we send you lots of love and can't thank you enough for your unwavering support and patience. In the meantime, please take care of yourselves, because [b]we will be back soon with more info about our release date.[/b]🌟

notes.title: YOUNG SOULS FREE DEMO IS NOW LIVE TILL OCT 7!
notes.content:
Greetings cool folks,


[b]The Young Souls demo is now available for FREE until October 7[/b] and we highly encourage you to play this gem. Jenn, Tristan, and a whole army of goblins are waiting for you in the basement for a unique experience, in which you will get deeply attached not only to the universe but also to all its protagonists. This demo will make your weekend and the week ahead much more special!

Also, please note that [b][url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0689-74B8-92AC-10F2]Remote Play Together[/url] is available with this demo.[/b] Beat up goblins on your own, or in co-op, the choice is all yours. 

[b]<!> DISCLAIMER: Young Souls demo contains flashing lights and patterns that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. If you or anyone in your family has an epileptic condition, consult your doctor before playing this beta. If you experience any of the following symptoms while playing Young Souls demo: dizziness, blurred vision, eye or muscle twitches, loss of consciousness, disorientation, involuntary movements or seizures - stop playing IMMEDIATELY and consult your doctor before resuming play. <!>[/b]

[i]Please note that the Young Souls demo is still a WIP, as a result, you may encounter a few known issues that the development team is already investigating and working on. If you encounter any issues, feel free to post a message on the Steam forum![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/7b691a850c6c45a69e2b31b6c7d9f23e1a923efa.gif[/img]

[h3][i]Here's what you can expect from this demo:[/i][/h3]

The Young Souls demo is split into two parts: [b]"The Beginning"[/b] and [b]"Exploring Dungeons"[/b]. We invite you to start playing this demo with "The Beginning", which gives you a quick overview of the gameplay and the story, and then jump into action with " Exploring Dungeons". Naturally, the choice is entirely up to you! After all, you couldn't please Jenn and Tristan more than by not playing by the rules. 

[b]💜 The Beginning[/b]

In this part, you will dive into the colorful world of Young Souls and discover the touching complicity between our two twins in the early stages of their quest. Explore the city, talk to the locals, experience the combat system, and go on an inspiring quest for adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/c8d031021a9bc6f34b745455ce2ab976ad7c0eea.gif[/img]

[b]⚔️ Exploring Dungeons[/b]

Young Souls has an incredible atmosphere, both in the city and in the dungeons. In this part of the demo, it's time for you to pick up your weapons and get to know the threats that await you. Explore the dungeons, fight and beat up goblins, all with your own fighting style, and armor. 

[b]This demo is just a preview of the quest that awaits you in Q4 2021[/b], but don't worry, the whole game is coming soon! We hope you will enjoy this preview as much as we love this title.

With all our love and all our heart, we wish you the best experience with this demo and a great weekend! We are looking forward to your feedback on the forums or even on our social media. Thank you for your patience, the wait is almost over now, so stay tuned!

notes.title: YOUNG SOULS IS COMING TO PC THIS FALL!
notes.content:
Greetings folks,

Today is a very important day for the whole team. We are delighted to reveal that [b]Young Souls will be coming to PC this fall.[/b] To celebrate this announcement, we've put together [b]a hard-hitting and exciting Boss Trailer.[/b] Indeed, there are many bosses that will stand in your way during your quest, here are a handful of them:

[previewyoutube=P-FwpyNvMkc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h3]FIGHT YOUR WAY THROUGH EPIC DUNGEONS AND BOSS FIGHTS...[/h3][/b]

In Young Souls, you'll fight epic battles, filled with our two teens' very own sharp dialogues. Each boss is unique, both in its design and in the techniques you' ll need to use to beat it. They will all give you a hard time, in the [b]four levels of difficulty [/b]in which you will be able to face them, but you’ll love them anyway.

Each dungeon is also unique (and beautiful), each environment has its own atmosphere, its own challenges as they all represent a force of nature (fire, ice...) and, above all, its own bestiary. Between [b]warrior or ninja goblins, giant spiders [/b]and [b]gigantic trolls[/b] (not to mention other surprises) you won't be bored!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/c84d07ff6b0591746abe7dd01e1f17fdfa1eb14f.gif[/img]

You have met some of our bosses in this trailer, but be sure that [b]Fazmore, Stiv Chaos, Yarlanda and Tetcha[/b] are not the only ones looking forward to hearing from you!

notes.title: Young Souls - Learn more about Young Souls story and gameplay!
notes.content:
We are 1P2P Studio (developers) and The Arcade Crew (publisher) and today we'd like to introduce you to our indie game called Young Souls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/b4b3a219a7f275078c3fa46e35fac5b92f1af4c9.png[/img]

[b][h2]What is Young Souls?[/h2][/b]

Young Souls is a beat'em up RPG (playable solo or in local coop) set between two worlds, Human and Goblins'. 

Orphaned from a young age, Jenn and Tristan's path crossed with a loving scientist, The Professor, who took them in and treated them as his own children. But one day, he suddenly disappears in mysterious circumstances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/ffe966ad5e424b5d8d505be68dec2d2f268fbef3.png[/img]

Jenn and Tristan looked for him everywhere. When they rummaged his office, they found a hidden cellar with a huge portal called "Moon Gate" that teleported them to a parallel world where Goblins live.

[b][h2]EXPLORE GOBLINS' WORLD AND GRAB SOME EQUIPMENTS:[/h2][/b]

A long journey awaits and you better get ready for it. Equip yourself, unlock hundreds of weapons (one/two-handed swords), armor sets (shields, helmets...), and accessories (bombs, grappling...) to fight hordes of belligerent goblins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/3139984e23f1d8cd00ccb0efe78b61a798ca6094.gif[/img]

You gotta travel through Goblins Realm and complete a dozen dungeons to save the Professor and Human's World which is threatened by an upcoming war. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/894fff0b53115e1c4d86e71881470a0764724825.gif[/img]

[b][h2]GET BACK TO THE SURFACE TO UPGRADE YOUR STATS:[/h2][/b] 

Sleep. Yes, you read it right. In Young Souls, you have to sleep to retrieve energy from intense fights but also level up while having sweet dreams.

Ready to feel that burn? When the day rises, wake up, get dress, and grab your "Happy Fit" token to hit the gym. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/22941a212a7010a77dd938c758ce661b454088b3.png[/img]
